geometryPolicy.rule: Every instance without a sourced geometry record is NO_GEOMETRY and is not inspectable.

crosswalk.bindingRule: R-16 PI-* is canonical. The R-17 fixture INST-* is a view-local alias, bound only through partId + corner + ordinal.

frame.note: Vehicle demo frame only. It does not anchor any R-16 mount frame.

joints.note: Chassis-side revolute axis; fictional hardpoints, not a production bushing model.
Ball-joint flag on PART-20-003 is a candidate serviceability flag, not a sourced joint specification.
Reuses the R-17 hub-revolute semantics; wheel spin remains UNKNOWN.

rejectedJoints.detail: R-16 PART-20-074 is DEFERRED; no PI-* instance exists, so no joint may bind a body.
R-16 PART-20-075 is DEFERRED; the R-18 tie-rod pose remains unpublished.
FR-20-002-FL is an R-16 mount frame with origin/rotation UNKNOWN; attaching a solver joint would invent a hardpoint.

conflicts.statement: R-16 declares PI-* should map to R-17 PartInstance.instanceId, but the approved R-17 validator requires INST-*.
conflicts.counterexample: PI-30-006-FL is rejected by DOMAIN-E-INSTANCE-ID in carlab.domain-contract/0.1.0-proposal.

conflicts.statement: R-18 uses its own INST-SLA-* identities instead of reusing R-16 PI-* identities.
conflicts.counterexample: 5 R-18 poses: 4 resolve by part+corner to R-16, 1 (INST-SLA-TIEROD-FL / PART-20-075) has no R-16 instance because the definition is DEFERRED.

conflicts.statement: The R-17 FL wheel-end fixture frame and the R-18 FL pose fixture disagree numerically; neither is sourced.
The R-17 FL wheel-end fixture instantiates a part that R-16 defers.
conflicts.counterexample: INST-CALIPER-BRACKET-FL references PART-40-048, whose R-16 instancePolicy is DEFERRED; it has no canonical PI-* identity.

conflicts.statement: R-16 PI-* identifiers contain no variant segment, so one ID could denote different definition sets under Gen1 and Gen3.
conflicts.counterexample: PI-30-006-FL is valid for GEN1; a future GEN3 variant must not silently reuse it for a different hub definition.

conflicts.statement: All 37 R-16 mount frames have no numeric origin or rotation.
conflicts.counterexample: FR-20-002-FL has only originSemantics "相对基准，未给世界绝对坐标"; no display matrix can be produced without inventing one.

conflicts.statement: R-16 stores the part-level qtyPerCorner on every ordinal instance; summing qtyPerCorner double-counts.
Grok R-23 publishes RUN-SLA-FL-DEMO-001 at inputRevision=3 against the R-17 fixture; this integration publishes RUN-R22-FL-SLA-DEMO-001 at revision 1 against a different input set.
conflicts.counterexample: Both are FL demo runs, but their input revisions and instance identities differ; neither may be replayed as the other.

conflicts.statement: R-16 carries 46 external source reference IDs that R-22 did not re-open.
conflicts.counterexample: PART-20-001 inherits SOURCED_SECONDARY from S01; this integration keeps it as an UNVERIFIED_REFERENCE, not an OEM drawing.

conflicts.statement: R-16 declares 12 OPEN quantity conflicts; the integration preserves inherited totals and physical instance counts side by side.

decisions.decision: Use R-16 PI-* as the only canonical instanceId. INST-* in the R-17 view is a declared view-local alias, never a second engineering identity.
decisions.ask: GPT-6 to either amend the R-17 prefix rule to accept PI-* or declare PI-* the canonical namespace.

decisions.decision: Bind R-18 poses only by declared part+corner+ordinal crosswalk. Never invent a PI-* identity for an unbound pose.
decisions.ask: Grok/Qwen4 to add canonical R-16 instanceId to future pose outputs.

decisions.decision: Keep R-17 fixture frames and the R-18 FR-VEHICLE demo frame separate. Do not merge numeric transforms or claim a world anchor.
decisions.ask: GPT-6 to define the RP-07 world-frame handoff before any absolute layout.

decisions.decision: Crosswalk R-17 fixture instances to canonical R-16 identities; leave fixture-only or deferred parts unbound and visible.
decisions.ask: Qwen4/DeepSeek to reconcile PART-40-048 whether it belongs in this variant.

decisions.decision: One integration artifact represents one explicit variant (GEN1 VAR-R16-BOF-ICE). PI-* identifiers are not assumed variant-safe.
decisions.ask: GPT-6 to decide whether variant belongs in the instanceId or in a variant-scoped project.

decisions.decision: All 37 R-16 mount frames remain UNANCHORED_UNKNOWN; no production display transform is emitted from the vehicle tree.
decisions.ask: RP-07 to supply sourced frame anchors before rendering the full vehicle.

decisions.decision: Interpret qtyPerCorner as part-level and each PI-* instance as one physical piece; derive BOM qty from instance counts per parent.
decisions.ask: Qwen4 to confirm or correct the quantity semantics in R-16 and future trees.

decisions.decision: Bind PoseRun to project revision and input hashes; never replay a run from a different revision or input set.
decisions.ask: Grok/Composer to key runs by canonical instanceId + input revision.

decisions.decision: No source-grade upgrade. R-16 inherited source references remain UNVERIFIED_REFERENCE; only artifact hashes are verified.
decisions.ask: GPT-6 to decide the evidence registry and verification workflow.

decisions.decision: Preserve all 12 inherited quantity conflicts as OPEN; show inherited total and physical count side by side, no silent repair.
